P.text: The gauge's total supply of staked tokens is zero during reward accrual periods, and lastUpdateTime is advanced by the updateReward modifier regardless of supply.
P.evidence_quote: if _totalSupply == 0, it returns the stored value without adding the time-based accrual ... Meanwhile, the updateReward modifier, called during user interactions or notifications, advances lastUpdateTime to the current applicable time regardless of supply.

I.text: Rewards accrued during periods when total supply is zero should remain accounted for and claimable, not be skipped.
I.evidence_quote: The GaugeV2 contract's reward accrual mechanism fails to properly account for emissions when the total supply of staked tokens is zero, resulting in reward tokens being transferred to the contract but never becoming claimable by users.

V.text: Reward emissions from skipped zero-supply periods become permanently stuck and unclaimable, causing protocol fund loss.
V.evidence_quote: Entire epochs of reward emissions can become permanently stuck in the contract, leading to protocol fund loss without recovery
